Infosys delivered a solid financial performance for Q3 FY25-26, reporting a **Net Profit of ₹6,666 crore** and **Revenue of ₹45,479 crore**. The company's operating income stood at **₹10,518 crore**, reflecting healthy core business profitability with an operating margin of approximately **23.13%** and a net profit margin of approximately **14.66%**. The **operating income** (Profit before exceptional item and tax) was **₹10,518 crore**, further highlighting the company's core business profitability. Depreciation and amortisation expenses for the quarter were **₹1,155 crore**.
